item.title: Gilead Visceral Leishmaniasis
item.description:
• Summary: Gilead Sciences has renewed its collaboration with the World Health Organization to help eliminate visceral leishmaniasis, a deadly parasitic disease. The company pledged 400,000 doses of its liposomal amphotericin B product AmBisome for expanded access in endemic regions. This long‑standing partnership aims to reduce disease burden through donated treatments and technical support.
  • MoAs: AmBisome (liposomal amphotericin B) binds to ergosterol in the cell membrane of Leishmania parasites, forming pores that lead to ion leakage and cell death. The liposomal formulation reduces toxicity while enhancing delivery to infected tissues.
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology, Fierce Pharma
